prompt: A hyper-realistic, conceptual image of an overweight, obese female figure sculpted entirely from smooth, transparent glass. Inside the glass body, vividly detailed junk food items such as large hamburgers, French fries, sugary desserts, donuts, soda cans (unbranded), fried chicken, ice cream, and processed snacks are clearly visible, floating or compactly layered. The internal food items are richly colored and highly detailed, contrasting with the clean, pure glass form. The background is solid white, smooth and noise-free, providing clean space for potential text. Lighting is soft and studio-like, emphasizing the transparency, reflections, and textures without clutter. The image represents the health impact of consuming ultra-processed, high-fat and high-sugar foods. No logos, no product text. Ultra-high resolution, conceptually bold, visually striking. --ar 1:2
